feedEpisode.description:
话说从“山谷音乐节”回来后的凯神，深受音乐熏陶，开始研究起了收听设备，他意外的发现：索尼降噪耳机的背后，竟然藏着跨越十几年的工程师故事。上个世纪40年代，井深大和盛田昭夫创业多次失败，做电饭煲、面包机接连翻车，直到靠做短波转换器才有了起色。那时候日本没有成熟磁带，工程师拿草酸亚铁烧制磁粉，手工刷磁带。录音机刚出来卖不动，他们瞄准法院、学校才打开销路。还在读书的大贺典雄，不断给设备提改进意见，之后正式加入并参与Walkman、CD研发。Walkman靠户外体验营销火遍市场；为了完整播放贝多芬交响乐，把CD时长定到75分钟。降噪技术研发之路格外漫长，早期样机像一套大型实验室设备，很多想法只能等待元器件进步。大庭宽团队硬刚行业不可能三角，推出 MDR‑1000X，XM 系列持续迭代，诞生全球首款降噪真无线耳机。2026年，十年磨一剑的1000x十周年典藏版和LinkBuds Clip诞生——索尼用实际行动告诉所有人，降噪不是隔绝世界，而是让我们更好连接音乐与现实。






索尼音扣 LinkBuds Clip将耳夹式设计与开放式声学结构相结合，带来漏音抑制、人声增强、标准三种聆听模式，灵活适配不同使用场景。融合索尼多年音频技术积淀与声学调校，呈现自然开阔、真实还原的声音体验；搭配可调侧翼撑架「灵动枕」，带来贴合稳固的佩戴体验。同时支持清晰通话与跨生态多点连接，从日常通勤、办公沟通到休闲娱乐，都能轻松切换。另有星夜黑、燕麦白、氧气绿和风铃紫四款配色，满足不同风格的日常搭配。

feedEpisode.title: Will the Blue Wave Be Bigger Than 2018?
feedEpisode.description:
JD Vance begs voters to give the White House "another chance" as a series of new polls show a political environment even more favorable to Democrats than the one that propelled the blue wave in 2018. 

Jon, Dan, and Alex break down how much "hopium" we should be huffing, a new ad from a Florida Republican breaking with Trump on immigration, and whether unexpectedly close Senate races in Minnesota and New Hampshire should have Democrats worried. They dive into JD Vance's advice to AI companies to simply stop "building Frankenstein" and unpack Trump's fixation on demolishing the Kennedy Center if he's not allowed to name it after himself. 

Alex talks about her new book, "The Steal: Four Right-Wing Hard-Liners, One Republican Presidency, and the Raid on America's Courts," which follows the conservative movement's deliberate takeover of the American judicial system. Then, Dan Osborn, the independent candidate for Senate in Nebraska, stops by the studio to talk to Jon about his campaign against Pete Ricketts.

feedEpisode.title: How AI Is Changing Talent, Not Just Tasks: Rethinking Where Human Judgment Matters Most
feedEpisode.description: The decisions leaders must make about AI today go far beyond what platforms to invest in: AI is changing organizational culture and leadership for good. In episode 1 of a special four-part series on how AI is changing leadership, we look at how the technology is changing how people interact at work, the new culture it is creating, and how leaders can get smart about talent management and strategy in this rapidly advancing world. Paula Goldman, Salesforce’s chief ethical and humane use officer, argues there's currently a big opportunity to redesign work around the complementary strengths of humans and AI. She explains how AI could reshape entry-level jobs and the development of future leaders, why companies need to rethink internal mobility and talent development, and how executives can prepare their organizations for an AI-powered workforce without sacrificing accountability, creativity, or trust. Goldman is the author of Manage the Machine: How to Harness Human-AI Collaboration at Work.

feedEpisode.title: vol.1430 错峰聊 / 三个海伦、成济弑君和阴阳奥德赛
feedEpisode.description:
在张无梦看来，诺兰的《奥德赛》并非传统的英雄凯旋史诗，而是一则叩问文明循环、古典性走向终结的现代寓言。奥德修斯并非荣耀凯旋的英雄，作为一名古典时代的人，他一身背负着木马屠城的血债、独眼巨人的诅咒，还有来自冥界亡魂的精神枷锁，最终踏入一个旧秩序已然失效、不再属于他的新世界。《荷马史诗》本身就在追慕失落的古早文明，而诺兰又站在当代回望荷马，印证文明崩溃与重组往复循环的永恒命题。奥德修斯最终双脚踏上伊萨卡的土地，可地理上归乡，对他而言，真的是故乡么？
